g.text: Every source-year the audit may use, from config/state_source_audit_sources.csv. A blank cell was
Step 1. The window is declared before any file is opened
– = read and excluded by a stated scientific decision; × = no file for that year can ever carry a state. Declaring the
two apart is what stops a gap in the source from reading as a year nobody noticed was missing; NPPES = National Plan
and Provider Enumeration System; DAC = Doctors and Clinicians, formerly Physician Compare; PECOS = Provider Enrollment,
Chain, and Ownership System; CCN = CMS Certification Number; NDH = National Directory of Healthcare Providers; FHIR =
